title.narrative: FUNDING TO THE PALESTINIAN AUTHORITY (PA) AS A CONTRIBUTION TO THE EDUCATION JOINT FINANCING ARRANGEMENT, IN SUPPORT OF THE PA’SEDUCATION DEVELOPMENT

description.narrative: The PA’s third Education Development Strategic Plan (ESSP III) 2014-2019 (extended to 2023 in line with the National Plan forDevelopment 2021-2023), seeks to build on the achievements of the previous strategies. It focuses on two systemictransformations; from a largely memorization and test-driven education model to a student-centred dynamic pedagogy and froma largely input and supply-driven function to a system-wide and results-based management structure and operations. The 2022Annual report is expected at the end of February 2023. Previous Annual Reports document significant progress across all sectorsincluding curriculum development, Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) and construction of new educationalinfrastructure.
